##    Make a report for the last week of measurements


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

path <- "/home/ajackson/Dropbox/Rprojects/Curated_Data_Files/PollenAndMold/raw/"

Categories <- tribble(~Type, ~Low, ~High, ~Category,
                      "Weed",     0,      9, "Low",
                      "Weed",    10,     49, "Medium",
                      "Weed",    50,    499, "Heavy",
                      "Weed",   500,  99999, "Extreme",

                      "Tree",    90,   1499, "Heavy",

```

##    Read in files for the past week

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Generate the last 7 days and their file names
dates <- as.character(Sys.Date() - 0:6)
file_names <- paste0(path, "Summary_", dates, ".rds")

# 2. Name the file vector so the dates are carried through the loop
# This maps each file path to its corresponding date string
file_names <- set_names(file_names, dates)

# 3. Define the safe read function
safe_read <- possibly(readRDS, otherwise = NULL)

# 4. Read files, skip errors, and bind into a single data frame with a date column
df <- map(file_names, safe_read) |> 
  compact() |> 
  list_rbind(names_to = "file_date") |> # Extracts the list names (dates) into a column
  rename(Date=file_date) |> 
  mutate(Date=ymd(Date)) |> 
  mutate(Category=str_to_title(Category)) |> 
  mutate(Status=replace_na(Status, "NONE"))

#   Read today's detailed report

Today_data <- safe_read(paste0(path, "Details_", as.character(Sys.Date()-1), ".rds"))

```

##    Make the report

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Height = case_when(
      Status == "NONE"    ~ 1,
      Status == "LOW"     ~ 2,
      Status == "MEDIUM"  ~ 3,
      Status == "HEAVY"   ~ 4,
      Status == "EXTREME" ~ 5
    ),
    Status = factor(Status, levels = c("NONE", "LOW", "MEDIUM", "HEAVY", "EXTREME"))
  )

ggplot(df, aes(x = Date, y = Height, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%a",     # "%a" for abbreviated day (Mon, Tue)
    date_breaks = "1 day"   # Show a tick for every day
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:5, 
    labels = c("None", "Low", "Medium", "Heavy", "Extreme"),
    limits = c(0, 5.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Allergen Levels",
    x = "Day of week",
    y = "Damage Level",
    fill = "Culprit"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```
